capabilities: process %%ai inline markers into proposed edits
annotate selected text with an instruction modal
review proposed changes as an inline diff with accept/reject controls
batch-process all annotations in a document
configure CLI path, model, and context scope
extras: No API key needed; it uses the Claude Code CLI with an existing Claude subscription. Desktop-only (requires Obsidian v1.5.0+). Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Manual installation requires building with npm. Note content is sent to Anthropic's servers through the CLI; the plugin itself makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to request and review AI-suggested edits directly inside notes.
summary: AI editing plugin that turns inline %%ai instructions or text selections into Claude-proposed changes shown as an inline diff you accept or reject.
